text: {"lessons":["I sold several winners quickly, then bought back broadly; I should judge each position by future risk and return, not by a desire to lock in gains or avoid admitting a mistake.","A stock being above or below my average cost is not a reason by itself to sell or hold; I should assess the whole account and make decisions without anchoring on my personal break-even price.","The sharp account-value drop after Period 4 is a reminder that past price moves do not predict what comes next; I should manage exposure and keep enough cash rather than trade on recent movements."]}
